strategies.name: Donchian Crypto Ensemble
strategies.source: Zarattini, Pagani & Barbon (2025), Catching Crypto Trends (study 9)
strategies.plain: Eight Donchian breakout legs (5 to 360 days) with trailing stops, each sized to a volatility target and averaged, long or flat.

strategies.name: Crypto Trend Filter
strategies.source: Faber (2007), applied to BTC, ETH and SOL (study 9)
strategies.plain: Holds the coin while its price is above its average of the last 20, 50, 100 or 200 days, otherwise cash.

strategies.name: Crypto New-High Breakout
strategies.plain: Buys the day after the coin closes at a 10, 20 or 50-day high, holding one day or until the breakout fails.

strategies.name: Crypto Weekly Rotation
strategies.plain: Each week holds the 1 to 3 coins with the best 1, 2 or 4-week return, only if above their 50-day average.
